developer: Bangladesh Agriculture Research Institute (BARI), Gazipur, Bangladesh
main_characteristics: It is a top cross hybrid.  Plant height 190-200 cm, height of ear 100-105 cm, weight of ear  250 g., seed weight / ear 230 g.,  seed/ ear 784, in rabi season silk formation time 85-90 days, grain orange yellow flint, 1000 grain weight 392 g., crop duration  143 days and 115 days in karif season, A profuse no  anthocyanin color here in first leaf sheath and profuse no  anthocyanin color here in  second leaf sheath.
source_org: BARI, via BSMRAU Digital Herbarium of Crop Plants
